---
title: "Métricas y Análisis Estructural"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(igraph)

# Grafo de ejemplo para ilustrar métricas
g1 <- graph( c(1, 2, 1, 3, 2,  3,
               3, 4, 3, 5, 1,  5,
               4, 2, 3, 6, 4,  8,
               8, 1, 9, 1, 10, 2,
               7, 6, 5,10))

grados <- degree(g1)
indices <- order(grados, decreasing = TRUE)
V(g1)[indices][1:2]

```

```{r}
betweenness(g1)
```

```{r}
closeness(g1)
```
